persona_stefan.md: Past thirty, and what defines him is the emigration for work that came after every plot this play stages - the last is the decade of the wars, the sanctions and the loss of Kosovo, which ends in 2008 when he was a child. Casting him in it would put an emigrant in a scene he did not leave from. He comes home for the slava, which the play does stage, but the leaving itself has no plot, and the honest fix is a plot and not a casting. He is held by the culture-position and the language position and answers to the pitch.
